body:
Follow-up to T-192, from the user: once a member has voted to close, no action may
change history relevant to their total — adding, editing or deleting an expense
that involves them, by anyone — and they themselves may not change anything on the
list.

The second half extends T-192 from adding to every change a voter makes: expense
edits and deletions, and the list's own fields (name, notes). The first half is the
freeze (T-157), which already refuses any write that would move a voter's amounts,
deletion included; kept, and now visible on the clients: Delete is disabled on an
expense involving someone whose amounts are fixed, with the reason.

Applied only to a write that would win last-write-wins, as the freeze is, so a
voter's stale offline edit is discarded rather than quarantined. Membership actions
(invites) are not list content and are not covered.
title: expense lists: a voter changes nothing, and nothing that touches a voter's total can change
